## History

Twenty-five years ago, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) proposed to [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), but their engagement was subsequently broken. Decades later, his son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) was introduced to Miss Lavendar by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), and the two quickly bonded. Stephen and Miss Lavendar eventually reunited and were married in a lovely ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge).

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), +3 more_
